title: Canvas santa bags
text: Canvas santa bags. These are quite weighty and will be able to be used and reused for a long time.  I love that part.  They are large, but not huge - the measurements give are accurate.  Holiday colors that are bright and strong.  I think these are well worth the investment.

features: PACKAGE INCLUDED - 2 × Drawstring Canvas Bag （in different styles, each measures 19.3”×26.8”)
PREMIUM QUALITY - Our Santa Sack is made of canvas, drawstring handles on the bag have been strengthened, durable and sealable. Easy to clean and care.
PERFECT DESIGN - This bag's drawstring handles design makes it easily open and closer. Roomy enough to hold both small and giant packages under your Christmas tree.

NICE APPEARANCE - Our Christmas Candy Bag's appearance is designed as North Pole Mail Service . When you use the bag carry gifts to visit your friends, it has an implication that you went all the way from North to send this gift for your friends.

WIDE APPLICATIONS - Our canvas bag is perfect as a holiday winter decoration on display beside the fireplace with your stockings. Ideal Christmas gifts wrapper. You can DIY this Christmas canvas bag on the surface and make it the one-of-a-kind.
